facts.value: You must log in with your HRZ account and enroll before you can start the test.

The placement test for the 'Courses for All Students' is not mandatory and does not lead to automatic registration in the respective course. This test serves only to assess your language level. However, it is strongly recommended to adhere to the corresponding result when registering for the course.

To ensure that your transfer is correctly booked, please fill out the transfer form as follows: Recipient: Johann Wolfgang Goethe University Frankfurt am Main, IBAN: DE 95 500 500 00 000 100 6410 - BIC/SWIFT HELA DE FF, Purpose of use: Please make sure to indicate the invoice number so that we can assign the incoming payment. The invoice number can be found in your confirmation email.
Your grade will be on your language certificate, which will be sent to you approximately 6 weeks after the end of the course by email.
